in_arabic.name: إتاب
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'w-t-b' which means 'to touch, to feel'. It can be used as a name for a child who is loved and cherished, or for someone who is sensitive and attentive to the needs of others.

in_pashto.name: ایتاب
